item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:45 HKT 18/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream will bring showers to the coast of Guangdong today. A trough of low pressure is expected to affect the coast of southern China in the following couple of days. Showers will increase and there will be squally thunderstorms over the region. With the weakening of the trough of low pressure, showers will ease off and the weather will improve slightly over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend and early next week.
